description: Inspects one collection and reports its fields with types and constraints, optionally mapped against its relationships and checked for schema problems. Use it when deciding how to query or extend a collection; get_collection_schema returns the raw field list alone, validate_collection_schema returns only the problems, analyze_relationships gives the cross-collection view. Read-only. includeRelations adds inbound and outbound relations and validateConstraints adds constraint findings; each costs extra requests against Directus, so leave them off for a quick look.
name: analyze_collection_schema
